name: Deutsche Telekom AG
summary: Deutsche Telekom AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated telecommunication services worldwide. It operates through Germany, United States, Europe, Systems Solutions, and Group Development segments. The company offers fixed-network services, including voice and data communication services based on fixed-network and broadband technology; and sells terminal equipment and other hardware products, as well as services to resellers.
